# LitZen

Canonical repository: https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum

LitZen is a local-first PySide6 desktop application for academic literature management. It stores projects as UTF-8 JSON files in user-owned folders and supports source metadata, notes, quotes, tasks, summaries, PDF workflows, BibTeX export and optional local Ollama-assisted features.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum/blob/master/README.md): English project overview, features, installation, file formats and companion export.
- [README_de.md](https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum/blob/master/README_de.md): German project overview.
- [EXPORTFORMAT.md](https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum/blob/master/EXPORTFORMAT.md): Human-readable description of `litzentrum-library-v1.json`.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): Version history.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum/blob/master/LICENSE): AGPL v3 license text.

Important files:
- `schemas/litzentrum-library-v1.schema.json`: JSON schema for the read-only companion export.
- `src/core/library_export.py`: Export implementation.
- `tests/test_library_export.py`: Regression tests for UTF-8, relative paths, missing PDFs and empty projects.

Privacy and scope:
- The default companion export does not embed PDF files.
- The default companion export does not include absolute local paths.
- The app is designed for local use and user-controlled exports, not server-side library hosting.
- LitZen is positioned against cloud reference managers, hosted reading platforms and institutional library portals.
- The project is not a Zotero, Mendeley, JabRef or Calibre clone; its core differentiator is folder-based local project ownership plus explicit read-only JSON export.

## Audience

- Academic researchers and students managing literature for papers, theses and dissertations
- PhD students and postdocs tracking sources, quotes and notes across multiple projects
- Writers and journalists who need offline, local-first literature tracking without cloud lock-in
- Developers and open-source contributors interested in local-first, JSON-based data tools
- Python and PySide6 developers studying desktop application architecture
